CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER
CO #: 041 Date Issued: May 5, 2026
Project Name: Summit Peak Brewery Buildout Owner / Client: Maple Ridge School District
Contractor: Redwood General Contractors Reason: Owner-requested scope change
Description of Change
At the owner's request, additional scope was added. Work covers replace supply duct section and frame additional interior partition.
Ite m | Description | Qty | Unit | Unit Price | Amount
1 | Replace supply duct section | 110 | LF | $55.36 | $6,089.60
2 | Frame additional interior partition | 64 | LF | $37.72 | $2,414.08
3 | Supervision labor | 48 | HR | $86.52 | $4,152.96
4 | Relocate 20A electrical circuits | 4 | EA | $378.66 | $1,514.64
Subtotal $14,171.28
Overhead & Profit (10%) $1,417.13
Net Change $15,488.41
Contract Sum Prior to This CO: $3,002,000.00
Contract Sum Including This CO: $3,017,588.41
Change in Contract Time: 7 calendar days
Status: Approved
Owner Contractor
